summary: Slow, scaling tank who zones with a delayed knock-up, silences with W, and stacks permanent HP with his true-damage ult. He has no dash, so dodge Q, trade while it's on cooldown, and use %HP or true damage once he's big.
threats: Q (Rupture) erupts after a short delay, knocking up and slowing. Walk out sideways the moment you see the marker on the ground.
W (Feral Scream) silences in a cone, so you can't use abilities. He often follows a landed Q with it to stop you escaping.
E (Vorpal Spikes): his next three autos fire spikes that slow and hit everything in a line. Don't stand behind your minions in a row.
Passive (Carnivore): killing units restores his health and mana, so poke only sticks if you keep it up.
R (Feast) at 5 deals true damage and executes. Each kill on a champion grows him with permanent max HP. Back off when you're in execute range.

matchups.why: Vayne out-ranges Cho'Gath and her Silver Bolts true %max HP damage grows with every Feast stack he takes. He has no dash, so Tumble dodges his delayed Q and he can't reach her before level 5.
trading: Auto him every time he walks up to last-hit, then step back out of his E spike range.
When the Q marker appears under you, Tumble (Q) sideways out of it and auto him during the cast.
Land three-hit Silver Bolts procs, then back off before he can follow with W silence.
Save Condemn (E) to push him off you if he lands Q and walks into melee range.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are yours: poke him with autos every time he farms. Keep Tumble up to dodge Q instead of using it to farm.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R executes you at low HP. Stay healthy, don't fight near his ult range when you're low, and keep kiting.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates. Every last-hit should cost him HP, even with Carnivore healing him.
matchups.jungle: He has no dash. Call your jungler when his Q is on cooldown so he can't knock them up.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. On-hit attack speed and crit; Blade of the Ruined King against his HP stacking.
matchups.remember: Tumble the Q, shred the HP.

matchups.why: Fiora's vitals deal true %max HP damage, so Cho'Gath's Feast stacks make her stronger. Riposte parries his Q knock-up or W silence and stuns him back, and he has no dash to escape her Lunge.
trading: Lunge (Q) onto a vital when he walks up, then step back before his E spikes add up.
Hold W (Riposte) for his Q knock-up or W silence; parrying either stuns him and wins the trade.
If he holds Q, walk out of the marker rather than wasting Riposte on autos.
Trade while his Q is on cooldown; without it he can't stop your follow-up Lunge.
matchups.early: Short Q-into-vital trades win levels 1–3. Don't take long fights where his E spikes and passive healing add up.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R hits four vitals and its heal zone wins the fight. Stay out of his Feast execute range while you finish the vitals.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates, then split-push once you're ahead. He can't duel you in a side lane later.
matchups.jungle: He's easy to gank with no dash. Ping when his Q is down so the knock-up can't stop your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; Blade of the Ruined King for his HP.
matchups.remember: Parry the scream, hit the vitals.

matchups.why: Gwen's Q and passive deal %max HP magic damage, so the bigger Cho'Gath grows the harder she hits him. Her W (Hallowed Mist) blocks his Q and spikes from outside, and her E dash steps out of Rupture.
trading: Stack Q with autos on him, then land the centre of the final snip for true damage.
Step into W (Hallowed Mist) when he casts Q or E so his abilities from outside can't reach you.
E (Skip 'n Slash) sideways out of the Q marker rather than straight back.
Trade after his W silence is used so he can't stop your combo halfway.
matchups.early: Take short Q trades once you have stacks. Levels 1–2 are even, so don't stand in long fights against his E spikes.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R adds poke and slows. Fight while you're healthy so his Feast can't execute you.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when he walks up to farm. You scale better into his HP than he does into you.
matchups.jungle: He has no dash. Gank when his Q is on cooldown so he can't knock up your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. AP bruiser items with %HP damage; magic pen helps.
matchups.remember: Mist the spikes, snip the HP.

matchups.why: Darius wins long melee fights, and Cho'Gath has no dash to walk away from Hemorrhage stacks. If Darius dodges the Q and pulls him back in, Cho'Gath's healing can't keep up early.
trading: Walk out of the Q marker first, then E (Apprehend) pull him while Q is on cooldown.
Hit him with the outer edge of Q (Decimate) for bonus damage and healing.
Stack Hemorrhage with autos and W, but back off if he lands W silence and Q together.
Fight next to his minions when his E is down so his spikes can't slow you.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 favor you if you dodge Q. Trade every time he walks up to farm.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R and his R are both executes. Stack Hemorrhage first and finish him before he can Feast you.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade often, then freeze once you're ahead so he has to walk up to you to farm.
matchups.jungle: He has no dash. Gank once his Q is down and pull him into your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Black Cleaver and bruiser items; boots that suit their team.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser's R steals Cho'Gath's stats, so his big HP pool works for you inside the realm. He's slow and can't dodge your Q well, and your shield soaks his E spikes.
trading: Q (Obliterate) him when he walks up alone to farm; isolated Q hits much harder.
Walk out of the Q marker, then E (Death's Grasp) pull him into your Q.
Shield with W (Indestructible) when his spikes hit you, then recast to heal.
Don't start a trade right after he silences you; wait for W to end and go again.
matchups.early: Trade with Q when he farms. He can't out-trade your magic damage early.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R steals his stats and takes him away from his tower. Ult after he's used Q.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while he can't contest.
matchups.jungle: He has no dash. Gank once his Q is on cooldown so he can't knock up your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Magic-pen bruiser items; Liandry's Torment for his HP.

matchups.why: Teemo out-ranges Cho'Gath and Blinding Dart cancels his empowered E autos. He has no dash, so Teemo can kite him and poke every time he walks up to farm.
trading: Q (Blinding Dart) him as soon as he uses E so his spikes miss.
Auto with poison and back off; he can't follow without a dash.
Keep moving sideways so his Q marker never catches you standing still.
Drop mushrooms in the brush and on his way back to lane so he loses HP to them.
matchups.early: Poke him with autos every time he farms, and keep W (Move Quick) ready to walk out of Q.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can execute you. Stay out of melee range when you're low, and let mushrooms do the work.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and poke. He has to walk through your mushrooms to trade.
matchups.jungle: Mushroom the river and his side brush; he's easy to gank without a dash.
matchups.build: Magic-pen AP items; Liandry's Torment for his HP.
matchups.remember: Blind the spikes, kite the tank.

matchups.why: Garen's Q silence and spin can win short trades, but Cho'Gath's Q knock-up and W silence stop his combo. Both have healing, so the lane comes down to who lands their crowd control first.
trading: Walk out of his Q marker first; you can't spin through a knock-up.
Q (Decisive Strike) him when his Q is on cooldown so he can't knock you up while you walk in.
Spin with E (Judgment), then walk away before his E spikes and W silence add up.
Back off after trades to let Perseverance regen his damage.
matchups.early: Even. Trade only after he's used Q, and don't stand in his E spikes behind your minions.
matchups.spike: At 5 both R's execute. Use yours when he's low, before he can Feast you.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on his Q cooldown, away from his E spikes.
matchups.jungle: He has no dash. Gank once his Q is down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; magic resist boots against his magic damage.
matchups.remember: Dodge the Q, then silence him.

matchups.why: Cho'Gath's Q and E spikes poke Nasus every time he walks up to stack Q, and Carnivore heals off the same wave. Nasus out-scales later, but he has to survive a lane where Cho'Gath keeps him off minions.
trading: W (Wither) him when he walks up so he can't follow you after a trade.
Stack Q on minions only when his Q is on cooldown so he can't knock you up while you farm.
Walk out of the Q marker; never stand still while he's in range.
E (Spirit Fire) the wave from range to keep stacking without walking into his spikes.
matchups.early: Give up contested creeps and farm under tower. Your goal is stacks and items, not trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives HP and resists so you can survive his engage, but don't start fights with it.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower and stack Q on cannon minions. He can't dive you early.
matchups.jungle: Ask for a gank when his Q is down; he has no dash to escape.
matchups.build: Grasp. Magic resist boots; tank items once you have stacks.

matchups.why: Wind Wall can't block Cho'Gath's Q or W, and his W silence stops Yasuo's dashes and tornado mid-combo. Cho'Gath's Q knock-up also lands easily when Yasuo dashes into a predictable spot.
trading: Only E (Sweeping Blade) in after his Q is on cooldown; his knock-up catches you at the end of a dash.
Stack Q (Steel Tempest) on minions so you have a tornado ready without dashing.
Throw the tornado first and trade before he can silence you with W.
Back off when he uses E; his spikes slow you and your passive shield won't hold.
matchups.early: Farm with Q and avoid trades while his Q and W are up. Your passive shield helps against his spikes.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R needs a knock-up; land a tornado after he's used W, then ult.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; don't dash into his Q marker.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks when his Q is down; he has no dash.
matchups.build: Conqueror or Lethal Tempo. Crit items; magic resist boots.
matchups.remember: Wait out Q and W, then dash.

matchups.why: Riven's combo needs every ability in a row, and Cho'Gath's W silence cuts it in half. His Q knock-up catches the end of her dashes, and Carnivore heals back her short trades.
trading: Bait his Q with your first Broken Wings dash, then step back.
Only commit to a full combo after he's used W, so he can't silence you mid-trade.
Shield his E spikes with E (Valor) and leave before the third one hits.
Trade in short bursts and back off; long fights let his passive heal him.
matchups.early: Farm safely and trade only when his Q and W are both down. Level 2–3 trades are his to win.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R adds range and an execute. Stay healthy so his Feast can't execute you first.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower until you have items.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks when his Q is down; he has no dash.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; magic resist boots.
matchups.remember: Bait the Q, dodge the silence.
